shared_prompt_contract: Image 1 is the authoritative runtime identity and proportions; Image 2 is the approved larger concept reference.
Create exactly one right-facing elite sword combat robot in the same neutral pose, never a sprite sheet or multi-pose board.
Preserve the cold-gray square chassis, linear limbs, short antenna, horizontal eye slot, hand positions, sword length and sword angle.
Add only one-logical-pixel shoulder caps, one short roof guard and a subtly thicker sword guard; no other armor or silhouette enlargement.
Replace only existing red-orange functional lights with deep purple and bright lavender; no purple armor surfaces.
Use deliberately coarse hard-edged pixel art with large uniform square pixel blocks and no antialiasing.
Keep the subject compatible with a virtual 28x28 box on one perfectly flat #00ff00 background.
Avoid horns, fins, backpack, thrusters, chest plate, bulky armor, enlarged body or sword, glow, trails, particles, shadow, floor, gradients, text and watermark.
runtime_policy: ImageGen is shape-language reference only. Native 32x32 review candidates are rebuilt deterministically from the audited ordinary combat robot frame; generated pixels are never directly downscaled into runtime art.
